standing: advisory diagnosis and suggested oracle/runtime-selection correction; not a design-unit acceptance

diagnosis.mechanism: jsonschema 4.25.1 Validator.evolve calls validator_for(schema, default=self.__class__). Retrieved document roots carry $schema draft/2020-12, so validator_for returns stock Draft202012Validator and drops ExactValidator const/enum/integer-type and x-opensip-order.
diagnosis.wrappedRootRef: ExactValidator({$ref: urn:probe#}, registry) ADMITS those instances
diagnosis.nestedExternalRootRef: mid $ref probe, both with $schema, ADMITS; stripping $schema in Resource contents with specification=DRAFT202012 restores rejection
diagnosis.fragmentDefsRef: ExactValidator({$ref: urn:doc#/$defs/nums}) KEEPS custom class because the resolved node has no $schema
diagnosis.notATrialCorpusCounterexample: trial 486986 cases used Resource.from_contents(full document) and ExactValidator({$ref: entry}); root entries silently ran stock; values rarely violate order at object document roots, so mismatches stayed 0

authority: identity-and-evidence.md §3 x-opensip-order vocabulary is the ExactValidator keyword
metadata-v2 check_metadata.py already strips $schema on Resource contents so ExactValidator survives $ref

suggestedCorrection.kind: minimally scoped oracle/runtime-selection successor of canonical.py plus caller registry construction; do not rewrite frozen schema bytes or historical trial corpora
suggestedCorrection.oracle: ExactValidator.evolve must keep ExactValidator when retrieved dialect is draft/2020-12 or absent; provide exact_registry() that stores Resource(contents without $schema, specification=DRAFT202012); original files keep $schema
suggestedCorrection.runtime: profile is selected at entry and applies to the closed registry; retrieved $schema is a dialect assertion, not a class switch (Rust trial already does this)

suggestedTests: direct ExactValidator numeric order refuses [1, true] and [2, 1], admits [0, 1]
wrapped {$ref: id} with $schema on the resource refuses the same after the fix
nested mid→probe root refs refuse after the fix
fragment {$ref: id#/$defs/nums} refuses before and after (already custom class)
x-maxUtf8Bytes still does not fail a too-long string at ExactValidator
pinned schema files still contain $schema draft/2020-12
